item.title: Ben Ogden wins historic silver medal, hometown of Landgrove celebrates
item.description: Langrove, VT. – For those who were up bright and early Tuesday morning, history was made overseas in Italy at the Winter Olympics. Ben Ogden, a cross-country skier from Bennington County, captured the silver medal in the men’s 15-kilometer classic race — marking the first U.S. men’s medal in that event in 50 years.
